sections.Profile:
Rob Zombie's Spookshow International pinball machine was created by Spooky Pinball in February 2016. Unique toys like Captain Spaulding and "Chicken In A Bucket" enhance the spooky experience. The game features voices by Rob Zombie, Sheri Moon Zombie, and Sid Haig, along with ten licensed Rob Zombie songs. Only 250 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: Spooky Pinball LLC
- Years made: 2016
